The first 1.3.0 beta brings your community into Flytower. Each server has a new **Stats** tab with leaderboards for playtime, deaths, mob kills, distance and blocks mined (all time, this month or this week) and a card for every player, built from play sessions and a daily snapshot of the game's own stats. Players can be left out, and the public status page can show the leaderboards too. Flytower can also answer slash commands in your Discord server: connect a Discord app on **System, Integrations** with its bot token, and `/status`, `/players`, `/leaderboard` and `/stats` work straight away. Give a Discord role a Flytower role and its members can use `/whitelist`, `/restart`, `/backup` and `/say`, with every command in **Activity** as "Name via Discord". A server's **Settings** can also post game chat, joins and leaves to a Discord channel through a webhook. See [Player stats](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.3.0-beta.1/docs/stats.md) and [Discord](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.3.0-beta.1/docs/discord.md).

Servers can now have a **web map**, drawn by Flytower's own renderer from the world's files, so it works on vanilla servers too and needs no mod. Switch it on from the **World** tab: it keeps up as players explore and build, shows where everyone is while you watch, and can be made public on the status page and in Discord. The panel also has **Help** built in, with the docs for the version you're running in the sidebar, a **?** on every page and search on Ctrl+K. **System, Disk** now measures with `flytower-du`, a small Rust program that's much quicker on big worlds. The Rust rewrite of the system helper ships too, but it's **off** unless you switch it on (see [Testing the Rust agent](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.3.0-beta.1/docs/testing/testing-rust-agent.md)). See [Web map](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.3.0-beta.1/docs/map.md).

This is a beta, and the web map hasn't been tried on a real world yet, so please use a test server. Testing notes are in [testing-1.3.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.3.0-beta.1/docs/testing/testing-1.3.0.md).
